Author: Ruby Blaire
Name: BoneSmith
Description: BoneSmith reads local Customize+ profiles, resolves linked templates internally, and provides a polished render-hook local-player apply flow with template toggles, Home status summaries, guided recovery controls, support links, orange tabs, obsidian title styling, and read-only Customize+ source handling.
Punchline: A polished bridge for using local Customize+ profiles.
